## Climate Data

Retrieve weather data (corrected to remove information rows) and label site names

```{r}

weather_nac <- read_csv("climate/NAC_weather_corrected.csv")
weather_nac$site <- "NAC"

weather_laf <- read_csv("climate/LAF_weather_corrected.csv")
weather_laf$site <- "LAF"

weather_hun <- read_csv("climate/HUN_weather_corrected.csv")
weather_hun$site <- "HUN"

weather_col <- read_csv("climate/COL_weather_corrected.csv")
weather_col$site <- "COL"

weather_bas <- read_csv("climate/BAS_weather_corrected.csv")
weather_bas$site <- "BAS"

weather_ker <- read_csv("climate/KER_weather_corrected.csv")
weather_ker$site <- "KER"

weather_bfl <- read_csv("climate/BFL_weather_corrected.csv")
weather_bfl$site <- "BFL"

weather_son <- read_csv("climate/SON_weather_corrected.csv")
weather_son$site <- "SON"

```

```{r}
NAC_30 <- read.csv("climate/NAC30.csv")
NAC_30$site <- "NAC"

LAF_30 <- read.csv("climate/LAF30.csv")
LAF_30$site <- "LAF"

HUN_30 <- read.csv("climate/HUN30.csv")
HUN_30$site <- "HUN"

COL_30 <- read.csv("climate/COL30.csv")
COL_30$site <- "COL"

BAS_30 <- read.csv("climate/BAS30.csv")
BAS_30$site <- "BAS"

KER_30 <- read.csv("climate/KER30.csv")
KER_30$site <- "KER"

BFL_30 <- read.csv("climate/BFL30.csv")
BFL_30$site <- "BFL"

SON_30 <- read.csv("climate/SON30.csv")
SON_30$site <- "SON"
```

*Key: s = space variable group, t = time variable group*

Combined climate space (range limit) dataframes

- Converted values in year column to numeric values instead of characters

- Created a new column for the census years

- Changed the census year column based on the month of that row

```{r}
climate_s <- rbind(weather_bas, weather_bfl, weather_col, weather_hun, weather_ker, weather_laf, weather_son)

climate_s <- separate(climate_s, Date, c('year', 'month'), sep = "-",remove = TRUE)

climate_s$year <- as.numeric(climate_s$year)

climate_s$month <- as.numeric(climate_s$month)

climate_s$year <- as.numeric(climate_s$year)

climate_s$month <- as.numeric(climate_s$month)

climate_s$census_year <- climate_s$year

climate_s$census_year <- if_else(climate_s$month < 5, climate_s$year - 1, climate_s$year)

climate_s <- filter(climate_s, census_year < 2026)
```

Scrub range limit climate data

- First make it wide

- Then make annual values

```{r}
climate_s_wide <- pivot_wider(climate_s %>% select(- year),
                             names_from = c(month),
                             values_from = c(`tmean (degrees F)`, `ppt (inches)`)) %>% 
  
  rowwise() %>% 
  mutate(ann_mean_temp = mean(c_across(`tmean (degrees F)_4`:`tmean (degrees F)_3`), na.rm = TRUE),
         spring_mean_temp = mean(c_across(c(`tmean (degrees F)_5`,`tmean (degrees F)_4`,`tmean (degrees F)_3`,`tmean (degrees F)_2`))),
         ann_sum_precip = sum(c_across((`ppt (inches)_4`:`ppt (inches)_3`)), na.rm = TRUE),
         spring_sum_precip = sum(c_across(c(`ppt (inches)_5`,`ppt (inches)_4`,`ppt (inches)_3`,`ppt (inches)_2`))))


#table(climate_s_wide$site,climate_s_wide$census_year)
#table(climate_t_wide$site,climate_t_wide$census_year)

#climate_s_wide |> filter(is.na(census_year))
```

Created time (long term data) dataframes

- Converted values in year column to numeric values instead of characters

- Created a new column for the census years

- Changed the census year column based on the month of that row (same as above)

- Filtered s climate data to only include the relevant census years

```{r}

climate_t <- weather_nac
climate_t <- separate(climate_t, Date, c('year', 'month'), sep = "-",remove = TRUE)
climate_t$year <- as.numeric(climate_t$year)
climate_t$month <- as.numeric(climate_t$month)
climate_t$census_year <- climate_t$year
climate_t$census_year <- if_else(climate_t$month < 5, climate_t$year - 1, climate_t$year)
climate_t_clean <- filter(climate_t, census_year > 2007, census_year < 2022)

```

Widened long term climate data

```{r}
climate_t_wide <- pivot_wider(climate_t_clean %>% select(-year),
                              names_from = c(month),
                              values_from = c(`tmean (degrees F)`, `ppt (inches)`))  %>% 

  rowwise() %>% 
  mutate(ann_mean_temp = mean(c_across(`tmean (degrees F)_5`:`tmean (degrees F)_4`), na.rm = TRUE),
         spring_mean_temp = mean(c_across(c(`tmean (degrees F)_5`,`tmean (degrees F)_4`,`tmean (degrees F)_3`,`tmean (degrees F)_2`))),
         ann_sum_precip = sum(c_across((`ppt (inches)_5`:`ppt (inches)_4`)), na.rm = TRUE),
         spring_sum_precip = sum(c_across(c(`ppt (inches)_5`,`ppt (inches)_4`,`ppt (inches)_3`,`ppt (inches)_2`))))

```

Extract yearly values from 30yr norms

```{r}
NAC_30_ann <- NAC_30 |> 
  filter(Date == "Annual") |> 
  select(- Date)

BAS_30_ann <- BAS_30 |> 
  filter(Date == "Annual") |> 
  select(- Date)

BFL_30_ann <- BFL_30 |> 
  filter(Date == "Annual") |> 
  select(- Date)

COL_30_ann <- COL_30 |> 
  filter(Date == "Annual") |> 
  select(- Date)

HUN_30_ann <- HUN_30 |> 
  filter(Date == "Annual") |> 
  select(- Date)

KER_30_ann <- KER_30 |> 
  filter(Date == "Annual") |> 
  select(- Date)

LAF_30_ann <- LAF_30 |> 
  filter(Date == "Annual") |> 
  select(- Date)

SON_30_ann <- SON_30 |> 
  filter(Date == "Annual") |> 
  select(- Date)
```

Create dataframes with 30yr norms

```{r}
s_30 <- rbind(BAS_30_ann, 
              BFL_30_ann, 
              COL_30_ann, 
              HUN_30_ann, 
              KER_30_ann, 
              LAF_30_ann, 
              SON_30_ann) |> 
  rename(ppt_30 = ppt..inches.) |> 
  rename(temp_30 = tmean..degrees.F.)
```

```{r}
t_30 <- NAC_30_ann |> 
  rename(ppt_30 = ppt..inches.) |> 
  rename(temp_30 = tmean..degrees.F.)
```

Combine spatial 30yr data with yearly annual data

```{r}
climate_s_wide_30 <- left_join(climate_s_wide, s_30, by = join_by(site))
```

Combine temporal 30yr data with yearly annual data

```{r}
climate_t_wide_30 <- left_join(climate_t_wide, t_30, by = join_by(site))
```

Create columns in spatial data with divergences from 30yr norms

```{r}
climate_s_wide_30 <- climate_s_wide_30 |> 
  mutate(ppt_diff = ann_sum_precip - ppt_30) |> 
  mutate(temp_diff = ann_mean_temp - temp_30) 
```

Create columns in temporal data with divergences from 30yr norms

```{r}
climate_t_wide_30 <- climate_t_wide_30 |> 
  mutate(ppt_diff = ann_sum_precip - ppt_30) |> 
  mutate(temp_diff = ann_mean_temp - temp_30)
```

## Plant & Endophyte Data

Read in dataframes from range limits data

- First the initial plant data (this has the specific plant IDs and endophyte status of plants)

- Then the census data from 2023, 2024, 2025, and 2026 (this has data on plant vitals)

```{r}
initial_plants_s <- read.csv("range_limits/endo_range_limits_experiment.xlsx - Initial Plant Data.csv") 
census_2023_s <- read.csv("range_limits/endo_range_limits_experiment.xlsx - 2023 Data Census.csv")
census_2024_s <- read.csv("range_limits/endo_range_limits_experiment.xlsx - 2024 Data Census.csv")
census_2025_s <- read.csv("range_limits/endo_range_limits_experiment.xlsx - 2025 Data Census.csv")
census_2026_s <- read.csv("range_limits/endo_range_limits_experiment.xlsx - 2026 Data Census.csv")
```

Corrected structure of column data (character vs integer) so that columns that need to be joined are consistent structure types

```{r}
str(initial_plants_s)
str(census_2023_s)
str(census_2024_s)
str(census_2025_s)
str(census_2026_s)
initial_plants_s$Tag_ID <- as.character(initial_plants_s$Tag_ID)
census_2023_s$Tag_ID <- as.character(census_2023_s$Tag_ID)
census_2024_s$Tag_ID <- as.character(census_2024_s$Tag_ID)
census_2025_s$Tag_ID <- as.character(census_2025_s$Tag_ID)
census_2026_s$Tag_ID <- as.character(census_2026_s$Tag_ID)
census_2026_s$Tiller_26 <- as.integer(census_2026_s$Tiller_26)
```

Relabel columns so they are identifiable with each year they belong to

```{r}

census_2023_s <- census_2023_s %>% 
  rename(Spikelet_A_23 = Spikelet_A) %>%
  rename(Spikelet_B_23 = Spikelet_B) %>%
  rename(Spikelet_C_23 = Spikelet_C) 

census_2023_s <- census_2023_s %>% 
  rename(tiller_Herb_23 = tiller_Herb) %>%
  rename(Date_23 = Date) %>%
  rename(Notes_23 = Notes) 

census_2024_s <- census_2024_s %>% 
  rename(Spikelet_A_24 = Spikelet_A) %>%
  rename(Spikelet_B_24 = Spikelet_B) %>%
  rename(Spikelet_C_24 = Spikelet_C) %>% 
  rename(tiller_Herb_24 = tiller_Herb) %>%
  rename(Date_24 = Date) %>%
  rename(Stroma_24 = Stroma) %>%
  rename(Notes_24 = Notes) 

census_2025_s <- census_2025_s %>% 
  rename(Spikelet_A_25 = Spikelet_A) %>%
  rename(Spikelet_B_25 = Spikelet_B) %>%
  rename(Spikelet_C_25 = Spikelet_C) %>% 
  rename(tiller_Herb_25 = tiller_Herb) %>%
  rename(Date_25 = Date) %>%
  rename(Stroma_25 = Stroma) %>%
  rename(Samples_25 = Samples) %>%
  rename(Notes_25 = Notes) 

census_2026_s <- census_2026_s %>% 
  rename(Spikelet_A_26 = Spikelet_A) %>%
  rename(Spikelet_B_26 = Spikelet_B) %>%
  rename(Spikelet_C_26 = Spikelet_C) %>% 
  rename(tiller_Herb_26 = tiller_Herb) %>%
  rename(Date_26 = Date) %>%
  rename(Stroma_26 = Stroma) %>%
  rename(Samples_26 = Samples) %>%
  rename(Notes_26 = Notes) %>% 
  rename(QAQC_26 = QAQC)


```

Creating transition year format dataframe

- First need to make pairs of year data (year t + year t1)

```{r}
plants_s_23 <- left_join(initial_plants_s, census_2023_s, by = join_by(Tag_ID))

plants_s_cy23_messy <- full_join(plants_s_23, census_2024_s, by = join_by(Tag_ID))

plants_s_cy23 <- plants_s_cy23_messy %>%  
  select(Site, Species, Tag_ID, Endo, Tiller_23:Spikelet_C_23, Date_23, Tiller_24:Spikelet_C_24, Date_24) %>% 
  rename(species = Species) %>%
  rename(site = Site) %>%
  rename(year_t = Date_23) %>% 
  rename(year_t1 = Date_24) %>% 
  rename(tiller_t = Tiller_23) %>% 
  rename(tiller_t1 = Tiller_24) %>% 
  rename(inf_t = Inf_23) %>% 
  rename(attached_inf_t1 = attachedInf_24) %>% 
  rename(broken_inf_t1 = brokenInf_24) %>% 
  rename(spike_A_t = Spikelet_A_23) %>% 
  rename(spike_B_t = Spikelet_B_23) %>% 
  rename(spike_C_t = Spikelet_C_23) %>% 
  rename(spike_A_t1 = Spikelet_A_24) %>% 
  rename(spike_B_t1 = Spikelet_B_24) %>% 
  rename(spike_C_t1 = Spikelet_C_24) %>% 
  mutate(inf_t1 = attached_inf_t1 + broken_inf_t1) %>% 
  select(- c(attached_inf_t1, broken_inf_t1))  
  
```

```{r}
plants_s_24 <- left_join(initial_plants_s, census_2024_s, by = join_by(Tag_ID))

plants_s_cy24_messy <- full_join(plants_s_24, census_2025_s, by = join_by(Tag_ID))

plants_s_cy24 <- plants_s_cy24_messy %>%  
  select(Site.x, Species.x, Tag_ID, Endo, Tiller_24:Spikelet_C_24, Date_24, Tiller_25:Spikelet_C_25, Date_25) %>% 
  rename(year_t = Date_24) %>% 
  rename(year_t1 = Date_25) %>% 
  rename(species = Species.x) %>%
  rename(site = Site.x) %>%
  rename(tiller_t = Tiller_24) %>% 
  rename(tiller_t1 = Tiller_25) %>% 
  rename(attached_inf_t = attachedInf_24) %>% 
  rename(broken_inf_t = brokenInf_24) %>% 
  rename(attached_inf_t1 = attachedInf_25) %>% 
  rename(broken_inf_t1 = brokenInf_25) %>% 
  rename(spike_A_t = Spikelet_A_24) %>% 
  rename(spike_B_t = Spikelet_B_24) %>% 
  rename(spike_C_t = Spikelet_C_24) %>% 
  rename(spike_A_t1 = Spikelet_A_25) %>% 
  rename(spike_B_t1 = Spikelet_B_25) %>% 
  rename(spike_C_t1 = Spikelet_C_25) %>% 
  mutate(inf_t = attached_inf_t + broken_inf_t) %>% 
  mutate(inf_t1 = attached_inf_t1 + broken_inf_t1) %>% 
  select(- c(attached_inf_t, broken_inf_t, attached_inf_t1, broken_inf_t1))
  
```

```{r}
plants_s_25 <- left_join(initial_plants_s, census_2025_s, by = join_by(Tag_ID))

plants_s_cy25_messy <- full_join(plants_s_25, census_2026_s, by = join_by(Tag_ID))

plants_s_cy25 <- plants_s_cy25_messy %>%  
  select(Site.x, Species.x, Tag_ID, Endo, Tiller_25:Spikelet_C_25, Date_25, Tiller_26:Spikelet_C_26, Date_26) %>% 
  rename(year_t = Date_25) %>% 
  rename(year_t1 = Date_26) %>% 
  rename(species = Species.x) %>%
  rename(site = Site.x) %>%
  rename(tiller_t = Tiller_25) %>% 
  rename(tiller_t1 = Tiller_26) %>% 
  rename(attached_inf_t = attachedInf_25) %>% 
  rename(broken_inf_t = brokenInf_25) %>% 
  rename(attached_inf_t1 = attachedInf_26) %>% 
  rename(broken_inf_t1 = brokenInf_26) %>% 
  rename(spike_A_t = Spikelet_A_25) %>% 
  rename(spike_B_t = Spikelet_B_25) %>% 
  rename(spike_C_t = Spikelet_C_25) %>% 
  rename(spike_A_t1 = Spikelet_A_26) %>% 
  rename(spike_B_t1 = Spikelet_B_26) %>% 
  rename(spike_C_t1 = Spikelet_C_26) %>% 
  mutate(inf_t = attached_inf_t + broken_inf_t) %>% 
  mutate(inf_t1 = attached_inf_t1 + broken_inf_t1) %>% 
  select(- c(attached_inf_t, broken_inf_t, attached_inf_t1, broken_inf_t1))

```

- then adjust date format to be a (numeric) year

```{r}
plants_s_cy23 %<>% 
  mutate(year_t = as.integer(substr(year_t, start = 7, stop = 10))) %>% 
  mutate(year_t1 = as.integer(str_sub(year_t1, start = - 4, end = -1)))

plants_s_cy24 %<>% 
  mutate(year_t = as.integer(str_sub(year_t, start = - 4, end = -1))) %>% 
  mutate(year_t1 = as.integer(substr(year_t1, start = 7, stop = 10))) 
 
plants_s_cy25 %<>% 
  mutate(year_t = as.integer(substr(year_t, start = 7, stop = 10))) %>% 
  mutate(year_t1 = as.integer(str_sub(year_t1, start = - 4, end = -1)))

```

- then bind transition year format plant data (range limits)

```{r}
plants_s_trnsyear <- bind_rows(plants_s_cy23, plants_s_cy24, plants_s_cy25)

```

Scrubbed range limit data so it's only including relevant rows (only POAU plants)

```{r}
plants_s_clean <- plants_s_trnsyear %>% 
  filter(species == "POAU") 


```

Retrieved long term plant data

```{r}
plants_t <- read_csv("long_term/ltreb_allspp_qaqc.csv")
plants_t_filtered <- filter(plants_t, species %in% "POAU")
plants_t_filtered$Site <- "NAC"
plants_t_clean <- select(plants_t_filtered, species, endo_01, id, year_t, size_t, flw_count_t, year_t1, size_t1, flw_count_t1, Site, surv_t1, mean_spike_t, mean_spike_t1)

```

## Combined Data

Joined range limit climate and plant dataframes

```{r}
joined_s_messy <- full_join(plants_s_clean, climate_s_wide_30, by = join_by(year_t == census_year, site))

joined_s <- joined_s_messy %>% 
  rename(endo = Endo) %>% 
  rename(tag_ID = Tag_ID) %>% 
  mutate(surv_t1 = case_when(tiller_t1 > 0 ~ 1,
                             tiller_t1 == 0 ~ 0)) %>%   
  rowwise() %>% 
  mutate(mean_spike_t = mean(c_across(c(spike_A_t, spike_B_t, spike_C_t)), na.rm = T), 
         mean_spike_t1 = mean(c_across(c(spike_A_t1, spike_B_t1, spike_C_t1)), na.rm = T))


```

Joined long term climate and plant dataframes

```{r}
joined_t_messy <- full_join(plants_t_clean, climate_t_wide_30, by = join_by(year_t == census_year, Site == site))

joined_t <- joined_t_messy %>% 
  rename(endo = endo_01) %>% 
  rename(tag_ID = id) %>% 
  rename(site = Site) %>% 
  rename(tiller_t = size_t) %>% 
  rename(tiller_t1 = size_t1)
```

Bind long term and range limit dataframes

```{r}
working_data <- bind_rows(joined_s %>% 
                             mutate(data_type="space"), 
                           joined_t %>% 
                             mutate(data_type="time"), .id = NULL )
```

## Plotting (pre-model)

Climate variation on its own

- Annual values

```{r}
s_t_dense_ppt <- working_data |> 
  distinct(ann_sum_precip, .keep_all = T) |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = ann_sum_precip, 
             fill = data_type)) +
  geom_histogram(adjust = 1.5, 
                 alpha = 0.8,
               color = "lightgray",
               position = "identity") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("#3b6496", "#0f4a1a")) +
  xlab("Annual Precipitation (Inches)") +
  ylab("Frequency") +
  labs(color = "Variant") + 
  theme_bw()
s_t_dense_ppt



s_t_dense_temp <- working_data %>%
  distinct(ann_mean_temp, .keep_all = T) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = ann_mean_temp, 
             fill = data_type)) + 
  geom_histogram(adjust = 1.5, 
                 alpha = 0.7,
                 color = "lightgray",
                 position = "identity") + 
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("seagreen4", 
                               "coral")) +
  xlab("Annual Temperature (F)") +
  ylab("Frequency") + 
  labs(color = "Variant") + 
  theme_bw()
s_t_dense_temp

working_data |> 
  select(site,year_t,data_type,ann_sum_precip) |>
  distinct(ann_sum_precip,.keep_all=T) |> 
  arrange(ann_sum_precip)
```

```{r}
                               color = data_type)) + 
  geom_point(size = 3,
             alpha = .3) +
  xlab("Annual Precipitation (mm)") +
  ylab("Endophyte Presence") +
  labs(color = "Variant") + 
  scale_color_manual(values = c("#257d74", "#3f7524")) +
  theme_bw()
s_t_ann_ppt_endo
```

adding some midpoints...

```{r}
working_data$precip_bin <- cut_interval(working_data$ann_sum_precip,n=6)
surv_plot_dat<-working_data %>% 
  group_by(precip_bin,data_type)  %>% 
  summarise(mean_surv = mean(surv_t1,na.rm=T),
            mean_ann_sum_precip = mean(ann_sum_precip,na.rm=T))

ggplot(working_data, 
       aes(x = ann_sum_precip, 
           y = surv_t1, 
           color = data_type)) + 
  geom_point(size = 3,
             alpha = .3,
             position = "jitter", width=0.01,height=0.01) +
  geom_point(aes(x=surv_plot_dat$mean_ann_sum_precip,y=surv_plot_dat$mean_surv)) +
  xlab("Annual Precipitation (mm)") +
  ylab("Survival to Year t1") +
  labs(color = "Variant") + 
  scale_color_manual(values = c("#257d74", "#3f7524")) +
  theme_bw()

plot(jitter(working_data$ann_sum_precip,amount = 0.5),
     jitter(working_data$surv_t1,amount=0.05),
     col=alpha("black",.05))
points(surv_plot_dat$mean_ann_sum_precip[surv_plot_dat$data_type=="space"],
       surv_plot_dat$mean_surv[surv_plot_dat$data_type=="space"],col="red",pch=16,cex=3)
points(surv_plot_dat$mean_ann_sum_precip[surv_plot_dat$data_type=="time"],
       surv_plot_dat$mean_surv[surv_plot_dat$data_type=="time"],col="blue",pch=16,cex=3)

```

## Modelling

GLM model with endophyte presence, precipitation, and interaction effects

```{r}
glm_endo_ppt <- glmer(surv_t1 ~ 1 + 
                        scale(tiller_t) + 
                        scale(ppt_30) + 
                        scale(ppt_diff) +
                        endo + 
                        endo:scale(ppt_30) +
                        endo:scale(ppt_diff) +
                        scale(ppt_30):scale(ppt_diff) +
                        scale(ppt_30):scale(ppt_diff):endo +
                        (1|site) +
                        (1|year_t),
                      data = working_data,
                      family = "binomial")
```

Summarize model results

```{r}
summary(glm_endo_ppt)
```
